cohort: Parturient adolescent and young women in rural southwestern Nigeria
finding: Low utilization of full antenatal and postnatal care services was observed, and related to personal health and economic factors.
mod_finding: Mothers who delivered by caesarean section were five times more likely to attend postnatal services.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at booking was 19.5 weeks (+/- 4.8 weeks).
